_meta.description: Key milestones of Lines 4 and 4A, oldest first. 'date_precision' is day, month or year. 'kind' is planning, approval, tender, award, construction, related or future. Only events whose source was read are listed; the foundation stone (reported as 24 Dec 2016) waits for a source.

events.title: Project report for Line 4: 32.322 km, 32 stations
events.summary: DMRC's updated project report for MMRDA plans a fully elevated line from Wadala to Kasarvadavali, at Rs 14,502 crore by completion.

events.title: MMRDA approves the project report
events.summary: MMRDA's authority approves the report for the 32.32 km Wadala-Kasarvadavali line.

events.title: State Cabinet approves Line 4
events.summary: The Maharashtra Cabinet approves Metro 4, at about Rs 14,549 crore, together with Metro 2B.

events.title: General consultants appointed
events.summary: A joint venture of DB Engineering, Louis Berger and Hill International becomes general consultant for Line 4.

events.title: Project report for Line 4A to Gaimukh
events.summary: DMRC plans a 2.668 km extension from Kasarvadavali with two stations, Gowniwada and Gaimukh, at Rs 940 crore by completion.

events.title: Five civil contracts awarded
events.summary: MMRDA awards the viaduct and stations in five packages: CA-08, CA-10 and CA-12 to Reliance Infrastructure and Astaldi, CA-09 and CA-11 to Tata Projects and CHEC.

events.title: State approves Line 4A
events.summary: The State Cabinet approves the extension from Kasarvadavali to Gaimukh.

events.title: J Kumar wins the Line 4A civil contract
events.summary: Package CA-54, the viaduct and two stations from Kasarvadavali to Gaimukh, for Rs 342 crore.

events.title: 234 cars ordered from Bombardier
events.summary: Bombardier, soon part of Alstom, wins the first order for Line 4's trains.

events.title: KfW approves EUR 545 million for Lines 4 and 4A
events.summary: Two German loans pay for trains, ticketing and links around the stations.

events.title: Alstom cancels the train order
events.summary: Alstom ends the 234-car contract, reportedly because the depot site was not settled.

events.title: Mogharpada depot contract
events.summary: SEW Infrastructure and Vishwa Samudra Engineering win package CA-160 for the depot.

events.title: Land for the Mogharpada depot
events.summary: The State approves the transfer of 174.01 ha at Mogharpada for Lines 4, 4A, 10 and 11; 41.5 ha is for the depot.

events.title: Suman Nagar and Amar Mahal Junction dropped
events.summary: Two planned stations go, for cost and lack of space. Line 4 now has 30 stations.

events.title: L&T and Alstom lowest for the trains and signalling
events.summary: Package CA-234: 39 six-car trains, signalling, telecom, platform screen doors and depot machinery.

events.title: First trial run, Gaimukh to Vijay Garden
events.summary: The Chief Minister flags off a trial on the 4.4 km stretch through Gaimukh, Gowniwada, Kasarvadavali and Vijay Garden.

events.title: L&T wins power and traction from Wadala to Cadbury Junction
events.summary: Package CA-298: power supply, traction, lifts and escalators for 22 stations, and SCADA for Lines 4 and 4A.

events.title: Parapet segment falls at Mulund
events.summary: One man dies and three are hurt. MMRDA fines the contractor and the consultants and ends the consultants' services.

events.title: RDSO certifies the first stretch
events.summary: After about 209 days of tests of trains, track, signalling and safety systems.

events.title: CMRS inspects the Gaimukh pit line
events.summary: The safety commissioner's report is awaited before the first stretch can open.

events.title: Trial runs resume, Gaimukh to Cadbury Junction
events.summary: No opening date announced; MMRDA aims for around Diwali or the end of 2026.

events.title: First of 39 driverless trains unveiled
events.summary: Alstom shows the first Metropolis train for Lines 4 and 4A at Sri City, built in 14 months.
